decisive_items: Shows approximately 60% infarction of the spleen
response.rationale: Cirrhosis with extreme thrombocytopenia and splenic infarction supports hypersplenism as the mechanism; normal coagulation and negative heparin antibody exclude DIC/HIT. Chronic liver disease is background, not the acute diagnostic entity.
